'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC male student from the Biomatic Club, found at night nearby the {{Rubi|Solis Lens Array|Lahai-Roi Resonance Nexus}}, talking to a professor, '''Tsugu'''.

==Dialogue==
:'''Kilani:''' Sir, I always wondered, why do you help us so much? Advising the Biomatic Club, getting us funding...
:'''Tsugu:''' Because I was once in your shoes! Being broke and fighting every other club on  campus... you learn there's nothing like having someone in your corner.
:'''Tsugu:''' Besides, who hasn't been a student? Looking at you reminds me of myself!
{{Dialogue End}}
